*Retention – Q3 2026 signup cohorts* (354 users who signed up Jul–Sep 2026)

• Day 1: *33.1%*
• Week 1 (days 1–7): *97.7%*
• Week 2 (days 8–14): *61.9%*
• Week 4 (days 22–28): *49.7%*

By month, Week 4 retention was Jul 52.9%, Aug 44.9% and Sep 51.3%. August had the weakest cohort. Early retention held steady across all three months.
A user counts as retained if they had any event in the window. Source: `users_data`.
Full breakdown: https://sheets.example.com/sh1
